summary: ReturnRide MVP tested end-to-end. Backend: all 29 pytest cases passed (auth, villages, matching engine, driver publish, booking lifecycle, demo payment, ratings, stats). Frontend: passenger register -> Find Ride (Hubballi -> Kalghatgi, Now) -> matches list (1 direct match, Ravi Kumar, Rs.248 with Rs.82 savings) -> Book -> ride tracking screen with 5-step lifecycle stepper (Requested/Accepted/On the way/On trip/Completed) works correctly. Auth token persists via secureSet on web (AsyncStorage-backed). react-native-maps shows the expected web placeholder card (RouteMap.web.tsx). No deprecated packages (expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch) detected.

integration_issues.issue: Only /app/index.tsx routes based on auth state; sub-routes like /passenger, /passenger/matches, /driver, /ride/[id] have no auth guard. An unauthenticated user landing on /passenger via deep-link can search matches (public endpoint) but Book will fail silently with 401. Consider a shared route guard or redirect-on-null-user in the passenger/driver layouts.

react_native_issues.issue: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — coming from a third-party RN component on web. Non-blocking but should be tracked. Reference: browser console output on /login and /passenger.

action_items: Optional: add auth guard (redirect to /login if !user) in /app/frontend/app/passenger/_layout.tsx and /app/frontend/app/driver/_layout.tsx so deep-links can't reach protected screens without a token.
Optional: surface the pointerEvents deprecation source (likely in Toast/VillagePicker overlay) and migrate to style.pointerEvents.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~740 lines — acceptable now but consider splitting into routers (auth, rides, bookings, ratings, stats) if features grow past ~1000 lines.
MongoDB _id is correctly excluded via projection {'_id': 0} in every read path — good.
All fare/rating math is centralised in helpers (one_way_fare/return_fare/CO2_PER_KM).
Lifecycle transition map is well-guarded (VALID_TRANSITIONS) and role-checked; invalid transitions return 400 as required.

pytest.ini enforces xdist -n 2 with loadscope — required test to be run with -n 0 to preserve shared module-level state across classes. Test file structured with class-scoped chained state; ran with `-n 0` to pass. Consider refactoring to per-class fixtures if this becomes fragile.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested core flow (register -> find -> match -> book -> ride tracking)

seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Backend already seeds 10 villages + 3 demo drivers + 5 demo rides on startup. Test file creates disposable TEST_ users (prefixed) — no cleanup wired yet but they don't collide since phone is random each run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_returnride_api.py. Because pytest.ini forces -n 2 loadscope but the file relies on module-level pytest.<attr> state chained across classes, MUST run with `-n 0`: `cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/test_returnride_api.py -v -n 0 --junitxml=test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Demo driver 9000000001/demo1234 owns demo-ride-1 (Hubballi->Kalghatgi). Village dropdown modal option elements are outside Playwright viewport bounds — use `page.evaluate` JS-click on `[data-testid=village-option-<Name>]` instead of page.click.
rca_of_issue: No unresolved issues. Initial appearance of 401 on POST /api/bookings during Playwright run 2 was a test-artifact: navigating directly to /passenger after a browser context reset meant no token in AsyncStorage, so booking correctly rejected. When the full happy-path (register on same session -> search -> book) is executed, token is persisted via storage.secureSet (web = AsyncStorage/IndexedDB) with key rr_access_token and booking returns 200 with a valid ride tracking screen. Root cause of the earlier 401 = missing auth guard on /passenger sub-routes, so a stale session could reach the Book action; the API correctly rejected it. Fix path (optional): add redirect in /app/frontend/app/passenger/_layout.tsx.
